title: "Services"
description: "Analytics consulting, reporting systems, research support, automation, and custom reports from Sun Data Analytics."
---

Sun Data Analytics helps clients make better use of the data they already have: spreadsheets, exports, surveys, transcripts, dashboards, operational records, and public datasets.

## What Clients Can Hire Me For

:::: {.index-list}
::: {.index-item}
### Analytics Consulting

Clarify business or research questions, define practical metrics, review current reporting processes, and turn vague data needs into scoped analysis plans.
:::

::: {.index-item}
### Dashboard and Reporting Systems

Design dashboards, recurring reports, metric dictionaries, source notes, and update workflows that are readable, maintainable, and decision-oriented.
:::

::: {.index-item}
### Research and Evaluation Support

Support survey analysis, evaluation reporting, evidence reviews, stakeholder summaries, and research deliverables that need a clear methodological trail.
:::

::: {.index-item}
### Qualitative and Mixed-Methods Analysis

Prepare transcripts or open-ended responses, build codebooks, classify themes, compare findings across groups, and connect qualitative evidence with quantitative summaries.
:::

::: {.index-item}
### Data Cleaning and Workflow Automation

Clean messy source files, standardize exports, document repeatable steps, and automate recurring pieces of reporting or analysis work.
:::

::: {.index-item}
### Custom Reports

Produce concise reports, technical notes, data briefs, and client-facing summaries with charts, tables, assumptions, and interpretation.
:::
::::
